exceptions.name: rsa
exceptions.reason: Marvin timing side channel in RSA private-key operations; no fixed rsa release exists.
exceptions.blockedBy: russh 0.64.1 and 0.65.0 both require rsa =0.10.0-rc.18
conditions: DGL generates Ed25519 keys; RSA is used only when a user imports an RSA private key for SSH authentication.
DGL performs no RSA decryption for a remote party; recommend Ed25519 keys and switch when russh ships a fixed rsa.

exceptions.name: grid
exceptions.reason: Integer overflow in Grid::expand_rows; fixed only in grid 1.0.1.
exceptions.blockedBy: gpui 0.2.2 requires taffy =0.9.0, which requires grid ^0.18
conditions: Reached only through taffy layout of DGL's own desktop UI; remote terminal data does not size the grid.
Overflow needs row counts near usize::MAX, far beyond any layout DGL builds.

exceptions.name: block-buffer
exceptions.reason: A panic caught inside a buffered digest callback can corrupt the buffer cursor; fixed only in block-buffer 0.12.1.
exceptions.blockedBy: sha2 0.10.9 (gpui_http_client 0.2.2 and DGL Windows storage) requires digest 0.10, which requires block-buffer ^0.10
conditions: Requires catching a panic from the hashing callback and reusing the hasher; DGL has no catch_unwind.
DGL hashes only short credential reference strings with Sha256::digest in one call.

exceptions.name: com.google.guava:guava
exceptions.reason: Native Java deserialization of CompactHashMap/CompactHashSet/MapMakerInternalMap can allocate unbounded memory; fixed in 33.7.2.
exceptions.blockedBy: Android Gradle Plugin 9.3.3 build classpath and its lint tool select guava 33.4.0-jre
conditions: Build-time only (Gradle plugin classpath and Android lint); not packaged into the APK or desktop apps.
The build deserializes no untrusted Java object streams; remove when an AGP update selects guava 33.7.2 or newer.
